d: Thanksgiving is a time for gratitude, family, kindness and giving back. As Americans come together to celebrate, Barack Obama urges people to spread love and ensure every family gets a fair shot. Vice President JD Vance serves Thanksgiving dinner to US troops alongside his family, honouring the men and women who serve the country. Vance also defends Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang against anonymous allegations and backs the Trump administration's decision to carry out a controlled explosion at an Iowa military facility.
